title: Why Strawberries Aren\x26#39;t As Sweet Anymore
titleZh: 草莓越种越大，味道却越来越淡？
summary:
你是否也曾有过这样的失望：想做一道草莓甜品满足口腹之欲，成品却寡淡无味？问题或许不在你；而在于草莓本身。一项2021年发表在《园艺研究》上的研究表明，多数受访者认为市售草莓的甜度不足。这也并不是因为草莓种植者的技术不过关——相反，这是某种刻意选择的结果。

来源：美国在线（AOL）；作者：Marco Sumayao；原文发布时间：2026-02-27 20:00:00

paragraphs.contentEn: Have you ever tried making a strawberry dessert to satisfy your sweet tooth, only to end up with something disappointingly bland? It's not you; it's the strawberries. According to a 2021 study published in Horticulture Research, participants said most strawberries they tasted weren't sweet enough. This isn't a case of underperforming strawberry farms, either — it's all by design.
paragraphs.contentZh: 你是否也曾有过这样的失望：想做一道草莓甜品满足口腹之欲，成品却寡淡无味？问题或许不在你；而在于草莓本身。一项2021年发表在《园艺研究》上的研究表明，多数受访者认为市售草莓的甜度不足。这也并不是因为草莓种植者的技术不过关——相反，这是某种刻意选择的结果。

paragraphs.contentEn: Back in 2012, Marvin Pritts, a horticulture professor from Cornell University, dropped by NPR's "All Things Considered" podcast to explain why store-bought strawberries were getting blander. Basically, strawberries have been bred over the past few decades to enhance desirable traits, including size, yield, color, and hardiness. Flavor just so happened to be less of a priority when it came to these breeding programs, which is probably why overall sweetness ended up becoming such a huge difference between store-bought strawberries and wild ones.
paragraphs.contentZh: 早在2012年，康奈尔大学园艺学教授马文·普里茨在做客NPR的《All Things Considered》播客节目时，就曾解释过为什么超市售卖的草莓味道越来越淡。原因并不复杂，过去几十年的草莓育种，主要追求的是个头大、产量高、色泽好、抗性强这些更受市场欢迎的特性。至于风味，在这些育种目标中则被置于次要地位，这或许正是商店购买的草莓与野生草莓在整体甜度上差距显著的原因。

paragraphs.contentEn: Commerce plays a role, too. Store-bought strawberries often have to travel long distances to make it to local groceries, so some experts recommend helping them last longer by harvesting them while they still have white tips, before they're fully ripe. The problem with this is the idea that strawberries continue to ripen after harvesting is one of the biggest false facts about strawberries out there. While a 1998 study in Acta Horticulturae found strawberries can sometimes get redder after picking, they also stop ripening, which means underripe strawberries don't get any sweeter.
paragraphs.contentZh: 商业考量同样在其中发挥作用。商店出售的草莓通常需要长途运输才能进入本地超市，因此，一些专家建议在草莓尚未完全成熟、果尖仍带白色时就采摘，以延长保鲜时间。问题在于，认为草莓采摘后仍会继续成熟，是关于草莓流传最广的误解之一。1998年发表在《国际园艺学报》的一项研究指出，草莓采摘后颜色有时会变得更红，但成熟过程实际上已经停止，这意味着未成熟的草莓不会再变得更甜。

paragraphs.contentEn: It all boils down to capitalism. Strawberry growers earn a living by selling fruit, so they need to prioritize the qualities that get people to buy. A 2017 study published in Agribusiness found that people who bought strawberries could be classified into three groups based on their preferences for the fruit's traits. The largest group, which comprised more than 65% of participants, preferred buying strawberries with brighter colors, larger sizes, firmer textures, and more intense flavors. Another group specifically prioritized size, external color, and texture over flavor and internal color.
paragraphs.contentZh: 归根结底，这与资本运作逻辑有关。草莓种植者以销售果实为生，因此必须优先考虑那些能够促进购买的特性。2017年发表在《农业经济》期刊上的一项研究显示，依据对草莓不同属性的偏好，购买者大致可以分为三类。其中，占比超过65%的最大群体更倾向于选择颜色更鲜亮、个头更大、质地更紧实、风味更浓的草莓。而另一类消费者则明确将果实大小、外观颜色和质地排在风味及果肉色泽之前。

paragraphs.contentEn: Why do size, external color, and texture matter so much? Because these are the three qualities we can examine without even opening the package. A 2024 study in the peer-reviewed journal Foods found that a strawberry's appearance played the biggest role in getting people to buy them. We equate a strawberry's freshness and flavor with how big it is, how red it is, and how firm it appears. Since we usually can't taste the strawberries before buying them, their looks are all we have to go on.
paragraphs.contentZh: 为何大小、外观颜色和质地如此重要？因为这是消费者在不拆封的情况下就能直接判断的三项特征。2024年发表在同行评审期刊《食品》上的一项研究发现，草莓的外观对促成购买起着最关键的作用。人们往往会根据草莓的个头、红润程度以及看起来是否紧实，来判断它的新鲜度和风味。由于购买前通常无法品尝，外观几乎成了消费者唯一的判断依据。

paragraphs.contentEn: During a 2020 online workshop with the Snohomish County Fruit Society, Marvin Pritts explained that strawberry growers in California and Florida decided to prioritize size and yield when it came to their fruits because that's what the market wanted; flavor was secondary to appearance and availability. As of 2021, the USDA reported that 98% of all strawberries grown in the U.S. come from California and Florida, so the odds of you buying these looks-over-taste strawberries are pretty high.
paragraphs.contentZh: 2020年，在斯诺霍米什县水果协会的一场线上研讨会上，马文·普里茨解释道，加利福尼亚州和佛罗里达州的草莓种植者之所以在育种时优先追求个头和产量，是因为市场对此有需求；与外观和供应稳定性相比，风味被放在次要位置。美国农业部2021年的数据显示，美国98%的草莓产自加州和佛州，因此，消费者买到这类更强调外观而非风味的草莓的可能性相当高。

paragraphs.contentEn: Since most commercial strawberries were bred for their appearance, you have to rely on other qualities to find the sweetest. One thing you can do is check the packaging to see if they're fungicide- and pesticide-free. Not only did a 2023 study in the Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry find that two common fungicides reduce the sugar content of strawberries, but a separate 2019 study in Scientific Reports showed that strawberries grew sweeter after researchers simulated insect damage on their leaves. Turns out, strawberries' defense mechanisms against pests also led to increased sugar production.
paragraphs.contentZh: 由于大多数商业草莓在育种时更侧重外观，想要挑选更甜的草莓，就需要参考其他特征。一个可行的做法是查看包装信息，尽量选择未使用杀菌剂和农药的产品。2023年发表在《农业与食品化学期刊》的一项研究发现，两种常见杀菌剂会降低草莓的糖分含量；此外，2019年刊登在《科学报告》上的另一项研究显示，在研究人员模拟昆虫啃食叶片后，草莓的甜度有所提高。研究认为，草莓在应对虫害时启动的防御机制，也会促进糖分的生成。

paragraphs.contentEn: You can also try to smell the strawberries. According to a 1989 study in Chemical Senses, scientists found that a stronger strawberry aroma made taste testers perceive a simulated strawberry solution as sweeter. You can essentially trick your brain into thinking your strawberries have more sugar in them by getting the most fragrant ones.
paragraphs.contentZh: 消费者也可以通过闻气味来挑选草莓。1989年发表在《化学感官》上的一项研究发现，草莓香气越浓，受试者在品尝一种模拟草莓风味溶液时，就越容易感知到更高的甜度。也就是说，选择气味更浓的草莓，可能会让大脑产生其含糖量更高的错觉。
